title: ScreenClip
description: A lightweight and simple mod for automatically sending screenshots to the clipboard.
body:
## ![meaning-of-project](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7296648b61f1c65b7ea7b0e3f5844f8236f46ad1.gif) Meaning of Project
![screenclip-bg](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9d52786fb1dde3f9c7ecfb9c5ec51e4994816909.png)
When taking a screenshot, the `PNG` file is automatically copied to the clipboard, allowing you to easily paste it anywhere **without any loss of quality**.

## ![note](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fed6dec08834a6b2f11a0826515174ef5e25768f.gif) Note
Currently, the mod is only available for:
* `FABRIC - 1.21.10 (Kotlin)`
* `NEOFORGE - 1.21.10 (Kotlin)`
* `FORGE - 1.21.10 (Java)`

There are plans to expand support to `QUILT` and all 26.x versions.

Functionality on `macOS` and `Linux` still needs to be verified.

⬇️ Any bugs, ideas, or suggestions can be shared on Discord
* Contact Discord: `thereizi`
